title: Artifact for PPoPP 2027 Paper #234: Revisiting Eigenvalue-Only Divide-and-Conquer Tridiagonal Eigensolver from Algorithmic Perspective
description: Artifact for PPoPP 2027 paper #234: the tridiagonal eigenvalue solver for CPU (LAPACK/OpenBLAS-based) and GPU (CUDA), with scripts to reproduce the paper's results. Part of the CPU code has been upstreamed to Reference-LAPACK (PR #1424).
